children: -- Associated Capital Group, Inc. (“AC” or the “Company”)
, announced today a preliminary range for its third quarter book value of $45.40 to $45.60 per share. This compares to $45.41 per share at June 30, 2026 and $44.66 at December 31, 2025.
AC will be issuing further details on its financial results in November.

, based in Greenwich, Connecticut, is a diversified global financial services company that provides alternative investment management through Gabelli & Company Investment Advisers, Inc. (“GCIA”). We have also earmarked proprietary capital to acquire or invest in new and existing businesses.
